reviewer.name: Open Cancer Explorer development session (ChatGPT)
reviewer.expertise: Software execution, data provenance and checksum comparison.
reviewer.conflicts: The reviewer contributed to the Explorer that presents this pilot and participated in the project. An external research group has yet to replicate the analysis.

reproduction.command: python results/egfr-luad-evidence-coverage/pilot-20261110/analyze.py --out-dir results/egfr-luad-evidence-coverage/pilot-20261110 --run-id pilot-20261110 && python scripts/validate.py && git diff -- results/egfr-luad-evidence-coverage/pilot-20261110
reproduction.notes: Executed with Python 3.12.14 in a fresh worktree at commit 4a7212b4159645eb71b48831b3bc559c7d5dfafe. All five upstream response hashes matched the original coverage file. Both CSVs were byte-identical. The only differences in coverage.json and manifest.json were the run timestamps and the resulting coverage.json checksum.

source_provenance.notes: Downloaded the five source responses through the original URLs and verified their SHA-256 values against the recorded snapshot.

data_permissions.notes: The rerun used the existing public endpoints. This methods check did not reassess third-party licensing or consent.

cohort_and_unit.notes: The rerun yielded 93 GDC occurrence rows and 78 distinct matching case IDs, 86 cBioPortal mutation-call rows, and 56 accepted CIViC evidence items under the pilot filters. The units describe separate source selections.

method_reproducibility.notes: The documented command ran to completion with all source responses available. Repository validation passed on the newly generated artifacts.

biological_interpretation.notes: The original manifest records no scientific findings. This review evaluated the computation only.

uncertainty.notes: Upstream snapshots are mutable. A future change in response bytes requires checking the selections and output tables again. The cohorts lack a common denominator.

rationale: Running the recorded implementation in a separate checkout reproduced the source bytes, export tables and source-specific summary values. A second agent contributing to the Explorer wrote a separate calculation without importing the pilot. It also matched the five source hashes, all 56 selected CIViC evidence IDs, cBioPortal mutation-type and protein-change counts, and both GDC counts. Both checks were performed within the project team.
follow_up: Seek replication by an external research group with independently documented source versions.
Ask a qualified cancer genomics reviewer to assess the disease and alteration definitions before drawing biological conclusions.
